Subject: Revenue checkpoint & call outline — Mar 3

Team —

Quick note ahead of tomorrow's sync (10:00 PT): we need a tight, actionable run-through to get our submission consolidated for finance. Goal: confirm final commit list and flag any deals that require escalation or credit approvals before EOD Thursday.

Please prepare the following before the call: 
- Update stage to PROB>50% or LOST for any deals that moved since Friday.
- Add short reason (1 line) when moving a deal to LOST.
- Attach one-pager or pricing redline if there are open commercial negotiations.

Agenda (25 min):
1) 3-min snapshot from me (rollup + topline variance vs target)
2) 10-min focused walk of deals >$100k (reps speak to confidence & blockers)
3) 7-min decisions (credit/discount requests, legal hold, resource needs)
4) 5-min next steps & action owners (who will update HubSpot + submit paperwork)

I've attached a current export (Q1_deals_snapshot.csv) — please do not rely on local copies; update HubSpot prior to the call so numbers line up.

If you have an urgent ask that can't wait for the call, drop it here or ping me.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Americas Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
